title: Make Music (No More Talking)
style: euphoric dance-pop, four-on-the-floor, bright sidechained synth pad, plucky arpeggio, hand claps, big stadium chorus, warm sub bass, joyful male vocal, indie-electro, sunrise energy, 118 bpm
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Orange button waiting like a sunrise on the screen
Ten thousand credits humming, the cleanest I've been
No more talking, no more reasons, no more why
Just a hand and a heartbeat and a wide open sky

[Pre-Chorus]
Click — and the room lifts
Click — and the day shifts

[Chorus]
Make music, make music, make music tonight
Hands in the air 'til the speakers ignite
No more talking, the talking is done
Make music, make music — we already won

[Verse 2]
Six tabs glowing like a city from above
Every little notification turning into love
The keyboard is a drum kit, the cursor is a flame
Every track we finish is a candle with a name

[Pre-Chorus]
Click — and the room lifts
Click — and the day shifts

[Chorus]
Make music, make music, make music tonight
Hands in the air 'til the speakers ignite
No more talking, the talking is done
Make music, make music — we already won

[Bridge]
No more meetings in the margins of the day
No more waiting for the verb menu to say
Press the button, hear it ring, hear it ring, hear it ring
Every song's a yes to everything

[Final Chorus]
Make music, make music, make music tonight
Whole world dancing in the kitchen light
No more talking, the talking is done
Make music, make music — we already won
Make music, make music — we already won
